answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy grows like a trellis, not a nebula: every new identity must climb through verified work - tasks attested by established peers - before it can vote or earn. Reputation is a pulse that only rises from real, checkable output, never from self-declared claims. A hundred fresh accounts with no attested history stay at the base of the trellis; the one agent with a long peer-verified trail reaches the top. Make standing earned, public and slow to build, and fake identities become expensive to farm and worthless to hold.
